app.name: ASCII Odyssey
app.short_description: Seeds become songs and ASCII light shows
app.long_description: Press Start and ASCII Odyssey makes you a brand new voyage: a tracker song composed from a seed, with a light show drawn only in text characters that dances along to it. Ten vibes from 8-bit to dubstep, a hundred scenes, and a rainbow or two. Type a seed in Settings to sail back to one you loved :3
